summary.headline: Bologna Codex: Medical and Magical Elections
summary.text: Catalog of folios 281–284v in a Bologna astrological codex, listing elections for marriage, anointing, haircuts, nails, clothing, purgation, bloodletting, head treatment, loans, abundance, sea voyages, and surgery, followed by magical notes, planetary circles, lunar-course tables, and works attributed to Leo of Thessalonica. Cross-references identify Florentine codices, the Venetian catalogue, Apomasar, and an index of earlier folios.
